title: Bosonic Error Correction with Fluxonium
summary: Bosonic quantum error correction (QEC) offers a hardware-efficient route to fault-tolerant quantum computing. To date, however, superconducting circuit implementations of bosonic codes have utilized centimeter-scale 3D microwave cavities controlled by fixed-frequency transmon qubits, with logical lifetimes limited by transmon bit-flip errors. Here, we realize bosonic QEC in a fully planar architecture by pairing a heavy fluxonium, whose $451 \pm 70~μ\mathrm{s}$ bit-flip lifetime exceeds that of any control qubit in previous demonstrations, with an on-chip Archimedean spiral resonator several…
